notes.title: Bug Fixes & Improvements
notes.notes:
- Fixed bug where game freezes after firework is launched

- Fixed achievements not working

- Fixed hint numbers not centered properly

- Increased spacing between grid and controls on the right side

- Made indicator for hidden levels in big candles more obvious

- Reduced game file size

notes.title: Pre-launch Update
notes.notes:
- Added scroll bar for level select page
- Added progress bar for level select page
- Added indicators for hidden levels
- Added hotkeys for quit (Esc) and toggle full screen (F11)
- Added pitch variation for certain sound effects
- Added animation when idle is unlocked
- Added speech bubble with gibberish sounds


- Improved hotkey icons
- Improved flicker (energy) boxes display
- Improved some levels with unintentional solutions
- Reduced delay between each move
- Reduced spacing between hint numbers
- Reduced the number of hints that can be displayed together

notes.title: Minor Update and Improvements
notes.notes:
- Replaced flicker (energy) bar with red and blue boxes
- Added facial expressions for player flame
- Added buttons to navigate quickly between levels
- Added hotkeys to most buttons, hotkeys are shown when mouse hovers over button
- Added interactive elements to level select screen
- Changes to many levels, challenging levels start hidden

notes.title: Bug Fixes & Improvements
notes.notes: - Fixed bug where flame is shown after undo - Fixed mute not muting some sounds  - All revealed hints are displayed together on hover - Adjustments to hint size and duration - Added numbers to indicate energy (flickers) lost or gained - Changes to some levels

notes.title: Bug Fixes & Improvements
notes.notes:
- Added new starter levels to better introduce puzzle mechanics to players
- Add BGM and SFX volume sliders
- Added symbols to different hint types, for another way to distinguish them besides color
- Added flicker (energy) consumption indicators/numbers which appear at the player's tile before each move

- Improved tile selection border to reflect the flicker (energy) consumption if player moves to selected tile
- Improved tile sprite to have identical horizontal and vertical separation
- Reduced possible interactions with level UI to minimize confusion

- Fixed Steam Cloud not saving data
- Fixed tile selection border not showing up sometimes
- Fixed SFX not playing sometimes
- Fixed BGM not changing when entering certain levels
- Fixed hints overlapping across adjacent tiles, hints are now displayed in two rows where appropriate
- Fixed auto continue to completed levels, players are now returned to level select
